sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 348 was established by Ordinance No. 20889, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 27, 1991. Ordinance No. 20889 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 348 is established on property generally located at the south corner of Buckner Boulevard and Poppy Drive. The size of PD 348 is approximately 14.110 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Conceptual Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.104. CONCEPTUAL DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual development plan (Exhibit 348A). (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

A development plan for each phase of development must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit for that phase. Approval of a development plan replaces any residential adjacency review or development impact review otherwise required by the Dallas Development Code. Each development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51A-4.803(d). In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set forth for the director of development services in Section 51A-4.803. Development on the Property must comply with the approved development plans. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided in accordance with the conceptual landscape plan (Exhibit 348B) before the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use delineated in Phase 4 of the conceptual development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.107. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are hospital, medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center, and office uses. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum floor area for all uses combined on the Property is 614,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.109. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage on the Property is 70 percent. Parking structures are included in the calculation of lot coverage. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Height And Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.110. HEIGHT AND STORIES.

Maximum height for all structures on the Property is 100 feet. Maximum number of stories is seven. Maximum height requirements shown on the conceptual development plan must be observed. In the event of a conflict between this condition and the heights shown on the conceptual development plan, the more restrictive requirement controls. The residential proximity slope, as defined in Section 51A- 4.412, shall not originate from the north, south, or east boundaries of the Property to further limit the height of structures on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.111. SETBACKS.

Front, side, and rear yard setbacks must be provided in accordance with the conceptual development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Parking Structures
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.112. PARKING STRUCTURES.

At least 40 percent of the area of the exterior facade of any parking structure along the western property line must be constructed of solid materials without any windows or other openings. All exterior walls for each level of an aboveground parking structure must be constructed of solid materials for at least three feet in height above the parking surface at each level. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.113. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Traffic Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.114. TRAFFIC IMPROVEMENTS.

(a) No building permit may be issued to permit more than an aggregate of 100,000 square feet of new construction on the Property until:

(1) a deceleration lane, as shown on the conceptual development plan, has been constructed;

(2) the existing curb radius from eastbound Poppy Drive to southbound Buckner Boulevard has been increased in order to facilitate a right turn movement; and

(3) the intersection approach has been restriped to provide a left turn lane and a through/right turn lane;

in accordance with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation.

(b) For the purposes of this section, new construction means work that increases the floor area of any use on the Property (initial construction) or, except as otherwise provided in this subsection, work that replaces any portion of existing floor area on the Property (reconstruction). New construction does not include:

(1) work that replaces any portion of existing floor area that is damaged or destroyed other than by the intentional act of the owner or his agent; or

(2) the intentional destruction by act of the owner or his agent of the remaining portion of a structure damaged as described in Paragraph (1) in order to replace the original structure. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.115. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b), all signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(b) No non-premise signs are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.116. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-348.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 348 is located on Zoning Map Nos. H-9 and H-10. (Ord. Nos. 20889; 25850)
